timing: Added after preliminary round-one results, before round-two assessment generation or review; round-two acquisition/training grid unchanged.
design: For each of six acquired R1 policy lineages and each seed, restart from the identical R1 terminal weights, on the identical R1 merged data, with the same 1000-update schedule as its R2 acquisition arm but without adding the R2 batch. Compare each R2 terminal model to its corresponding no-second-batch terminal model on one fresh common assessment.
interpretation: Matched additional control isolates the incremental data-update policy conditional on the existing R1 lineage; it does not hold minibatch samples identical after dataset sizes change.
